rows.definition: `InterKernelGapSumUs` is the optional per-repetition field on performance receipts (schema fak-native-performance-receipt/v3) recording the summed microseconds the device sat idle between kernel launches during one decode step. This row positions the v3 host-overhead decomposition symbol so lookup does not conflate it with the in-kernel decode lane layout or the umbrella gateway-engine domain.
rows.distinction: Use `InterKernelGapSumUs` for the recorded inter-launch idle sum on a v3 receipt repetition. Unlike `inKernelDecodeV41Lanes`, it measures a timing gap, not the lane layout of in-kernel decoding; unlike `gateway-engine`, it is one receipt field, not the umbrella domain.
